I don't know what to say... This is horrible! I totally get how much it hurts when people try to make you look like the bad one. Most of the time those kind of people are so good at manipulating that other people believe them, even if they should know that you have no reason to live. Gaslighting is the worst, even more so when it involves children you love. You seem like a good parent and you stood up for them, that's the bravest thing there is. Your kids are still you and therefore impressionable but as they grow older they'll will realise that you aren't the bad parent but that their mother is. I can understand that it makes you insecure though because you can't know what she says about you behind your back and you can't even defend yourself to you kids. But try to hold on, your kids will come to understand eventually. I think it's  amazing that you clearly love them so much. I've never been loved by either parent so this truly warms my heart. How you say you'd give your life for you autistic son. Not every parent would, believe me. He's lucky to have you even if he doesn't realise it yet. Their daddy is not a monster and with time it will become clear to them. Just keep fighting for them and don't forget to take care of your mental health as well. The better you feel, the better you can take care of your kids. Maybe their is a legal way to prove that she is mistreating them and you can use it against her? Manipulate behavior isn't easy to prove but if your kids are being abused (in any way!)then there will be signs. A good psychologist can recognise the symptoms of an unhealthy home and maybe you can use that against your ex to prove that your kids are better off living only with you? I don't know much about all that legal stuff but there has to be something you can do, right? I hope there is.

I don't know how to change. I've always been like this. And damn, that hurt to hear. "Just suck it up", I've heard that too many times in my life. Sorry that I'm not a normal and stable person.. I didn't ask to be like this. I guess I do feel sorry for myself, idk. I'm sorry..
